v1_scan_instances_per_session.note: EV8 is structurally equivalent to DL-008 in v1 auditing. All agents running DL-008 scans also detect EV8 on the same data. No separate EV8 scan exists in v1 — it is folded into DL-008 agent workflows.

scan_agents_vs_content_agents.finding: 53 agent deploy events performed scans on the same defect classes across 6 sessions — zero content changes resulted. Every scan confirmed the same structural state.

section_2_v2_equivalent_scans.description: Under Framework v2's scan-once/consume-many model (per S203 Scan Engine Spec), each defect class is scanned exactly once at session T0 pre-flight. Results are written to immutable artifacts consumed by all downstream boards.

co_detects: DL-026 (empty non-CC slots — routed to PG-005)
DL_008.methodology: AM-1 within-object extraction — CorrectChoice + EW[CC] from same brace-delimited object
DL_008.gold_standard_test: Pack B must return 0 DL-008 (CC-before-QID format previously caused DL-029 false positives)

DL_026.note: Unified single-pass detection of three defect classes previously requiring 2-3 separate agent-level analyses

co_detects: DL-027 closing-tag variant (Pattern C absence of signature phrases)
DL_013.detection_method: Dual-phrase signature matching + pair-wise Jaccard similarity (>0.85 = Pattern B, >0.70 = Pattern D)

DL_010.note: Advisory only — automated detection has ~94% FP rate. Outputs are WARN, never HARD_BLOCK.
DL_010.detection_method: Tier 1 lexical overlap Jaccard between EW[L] and Choices[L] text. Tier 2 cross-choice best-match comparison. Tier 3 numeric mismatch heuristic.

co_detects: DL-009 suspects (wrong standard cited for topic)
EV3.detection_method: Citation regex library (ASC/COSO/IAS/IFRS/GAAP/FASB/IMA/SOX/PCAOB/AICPA) + cognitive level waiver (Remember/Understand exempt) + principle-name extended check

EV8.note: MCQ path: delegates to PG-001 output (zero additional runtime). Case path: scans case items for correct-answer slot violations using case-specific object structure.
EV8.runtime_overhead: ~0ms for MCQ path (reuses PG-001). ~2000ms for case-item path.

section_2_v2_equivalent_scans.note: PG-001, PG-005, PG-004 run in parallel on same item set (Gate 1). PG-003, PG-008, PG-002 run in parallel (Gate 2). PG-006, PG-007 run in parallel (Gate 4). Actual wall-clock time is dominated by slowest parallel group, not sum.

section_3_redundancy_ratio.description: Redundancy Ratio = v1 scan instances / v2 scan instances per defect class per session

EV8.redundancy_ratio: N/A — EV8 is net-new explicit scan in v2

section_3_redundancy_ratio.interpretation: For every 1 scan run under v2, v1 ran an average of 2.31 redundant agent-level scan instances per defect class per session. The worst offender (DL-008) required 3.67× more scan instances under v1 — 5 agents independently scanning the same ExplanationWrong fields and reaching identical conclusions.

section_4_artifact_consumption.description: Under the scan-once/consume-many model, each scan artifact is produced once at T0 pre-flight and consumed by all downstream boards. The following maps which boards consume which artifacts.

Registry_Board.purpose: Maintains QID registry, question_state transitions, TemplateFamily classification

Quality_Board.purpose: Technical accuracy, explanation quality, distractor quality, learner safety — merged from v1's Technical+EQS+DQS+LearnerSafety boards (per S200 board rationalization, 70% overlap)

Governance_Board.purpose: Process integrity, hash stability, answer-key change detection, session isolation

Certification_Board.purpose: Per-item CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions, state transitions to Certified

Throughput_Board.purpose: Pipeline metrics, session compression analysis, completion forecasting

PG_011_Identity.description: Identifies every item's compound key (QID+CC+pack), template family, and cross-pack uniqueness
consuming_boards: Certification Board (identity precondition per S202 Amendment 1)
Quality Board (identity verification before content review)
PG_011_Identity.v1_equivalent: Identity fields were verified ad-hoc by 2-3 agents per session (QID format, CC presence, pack attribution) — no formal identity scan existed. S320 proved identity failures cause remediation errors (stale CC values).

PG_001_DL008.description: Detects non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] — highest-priority learner-safety defect
PG_001_DL008.v1_equivalent: Scanned by 4-5 agents per session (22 total across 6 sessions in S809-S810 chain). Result always identical within session.

PG_005_DL026.description: Detects empty/absent non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots — unified DL-026+DL-025+DL-021 detection
consuming_boards: Certification Board (SOFT_BLOCK — items with DL-026 cannot be certified)
PG_005_DL026.v1_equivalent: Scanned by 2-3 agents per session (14 total across 5 sessions). S320: stale CorrectChoice values made DL-026 inventory unreliable — PG-005 solves this via within-object extraction.

PG_003_DL013.description: Detects template boilerplate in ExplanationWrong text — dual-phrase + Jaccard similarity analysis
consuming_boards: Certification Board (SOFT_BLOCK — boilerplate explanations violate CAQS §4.3 EV2)
PG_003_DL013.v1_equivalent: Scanned by 2-3 agents per session (7 total across 3 sessions). DL-013 remediation cycles consumed 1,736+ field rewrites across sessions because boilerplate wasn't systematically detected at T0.

consumption_summary.note: Each board consumes multiple artifacts without re-executing the scan. v1 would require 21+ separate agent deploy events (each running its own scan) to achieve the same board-level visibility. v2 achieves this with 6 scan executions.

cross_session_6_session_window.note: Lower cross-session rate because EV8 was previously embedded in DL-008 scans (no separate v1 count) but is an explicit v2 scan. Net reduction: 23 redundant agent deploy events across 6 sessions.

estimated_time_savings_minutes.note: Conservative estimate: each v1 agent's independent DL-008/DL-026/DL-013/DL-010/EV3 scan takes ~45 seconds (file load + field extraction + comparison + reporting). Does not include board deliberation time saved by having pre-computed artifact results.
